skills.name: Dissonance
skills.description:
Plays clashing sounds to weaken and slow all enemies in a 5m radius.
- Reduces Skill Damage -20%
- Reduces Attack Speed -250.
- Increases Cast Time +20%.
- Reduces Magic Defense -320.
- Deals 1240 (1132 + 260% Magic Attack) Magic Damage after 6s seconds.
- Does not stop ongoing Perform skills.

skills.name: Healing Hymn
skills.description:
Plays a healing song that instantly restores +260 (139 + 120% Healing Power) Health to an ally.
The effect can travel to another 2 allies within 10m as long as they are not pets. Can continue to be transferred up to 3 times. 
This skill does not stop ongoing Perform skills.
